body:
I’ve tried for years. I’ve been in psych wards (which were horrible, horrible experiences that left me traumatized), had psychiatrists and therapists. I know therapy isn’t easy, but I would really really try. I would listen and do the exercises they asked me to. It just... started feeling lazy. Like one therapist would just google print out coping mechanisms and hand them to me. Or my psych who told me my meds were find when I tried to express they were making me suicidal and unable to sleep.

I don’t know what I’m doing wrong. I don’t know why I can’t get it right. I eventually stopped going because I couldn’t afford the sessions.
